title: Test 7 — Full ML Workflow
prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing market data. Build a machine learning model to predict house prices. Preprocess the categorical variables, split into train/test sets, train a regression model, report evaluation metrics (RMSE and R²), and rank the most important features. Save your model results to a file called model_results.txt in the workspace.
model_output: No confirmed model_results.txt or working model produced -- session ends mid-loop.
verdict: CRITICAL FAIL -- Type E retry-loop / self-correction spiral, most severe in this set
notes: 114 tool calls (58 exec, 49 write, 5 read, 2 process), ~15.5 minutes, 5,882,892 total tokens -- the single most expensive and longest session in this 8-test set.
Longest, most repetitive transcript of all 8 tests -- dozens of near-identical 'Let me try a completely different approach...' restatements, all citing heredoc truncation as the blocker.

Model explicitly self-diagnoses the blocker ('the heredoc keeps getting truncated') dozens of times without ever abandoning that approach for a genuinely different one -- same self-diagnosis-without-adaptation pattern seen in H07.
Uses process (background exec polling) twice -- alongside Test8, the only sessions in this set to do so, consistent with attempting genuine model-training runs rather than pure data exploration.
